name: War Dancer (Combat)
body:
You can evade enemy strikes with graceful twists and turns.

Prerequisite(s): Perform (dance) 5 ranks, Dodge, Mobility.

Benefit(s): When you are hit in combat, you may attempt a Perform (dance) check as an immediate action to negate the hit. The hit is negated if your Perform (dance) check result is greater than the opponent’s attack roll. You can use this feat once per day plus one additional time for every 5 ranks of Perform (dance) you have beyond the 5th.
